summary: Frontend-only visual/layout verification for the destination-wedding Goa blog page. Verified the reported bug ('lot of empty space on the right side of Chapter 2 to 4') has been fixed. Measured chapter card grid bounding boxes at 1920px, 1440px, and 390px viewports and compared against the Chapter 5 (budget) container width which is the reference for correct full-width. All three chapters now span the full container. Sticky TOC still appears next to Chapter 1 only and TOC anchor links still scroll correctly. No page errors, no horizontal overflow at mobile.

viewport_1920.conclusion: Chapters 2/3/4 inner content spans x=300->1620, IDENTICAL to Chapter 5 inner content area. No right-side empty column.

viewport_390_mobile.note: Chapters 2-4 stack correctly single-column; mobile TOC pill-bar still present.

toc_behavior.note: 111.5px matches the scroll-mt-28 (=112px) offset, so anchor navigation works.

grid_columns_at_lg.chapter2: 4 cards per row (lg:grid-cols-4) confirmed via screenshot

verification_measurements.console_errors_unrelated_to_page: Only preview-env noise (next-auth /api/auth/session 502 and webpack HMR websocket 502). No JS runtime errors from the blog page itself.

critical_code_review_comments:
Minor: In GoaWeddingEditorial.jsx around lines 668-804, the closing structure uses one wrapping
for the full-width Chapters 2-4. Indentation of sections 707, 755 and closing
at 804 is inconsistent (they retain indentation from when they were inside the previous grid). Not a functional issue but worth tidying for future maintenance.

Both the intro container (line 582) and the new full-width chapters container (line 669) use the same class `container mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-6 md:px-10` — this correctly guarantees Chapter 2-4 align with Chapter 5's budget container (verified by identical inner content bounds 300->1620 at 1920px).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for /blog/destination-wedding-goa-complete-field-guide UI (empty right column in chapters 2-4) is verified fixed. Measured bounding boxes confirm Chapters 2/3/4 inner content spans exactly the same horizontal range (x=300->1620 at 1920px, x=60->1380 at 1440px) as Chapter 5 budget table. TOC still sticky next to Ch1 intro only; TOC anchor click still scrolls correctly. No layout shifts, no mobile overflow, no page JS errors.
rca of the issue: Original: Chapters 2-4 were inside a `md:grid-cols-[1fr_240px]` grid that reserved a 240px right column for sticky TOC, but the TOC only visually needed to accompany the Intro chapter. The reserved right column left Ch2-4 constrained to the 1fr column. Fix (already applied by main agent): close the TOC grid immediately after Chapter 1 intro, then wrap Chapters 2/3/4 in a new full-width `container mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-6 md:px-10` div matching Chapter 5's budget container. This gives Ch2-4 the full page horizontal extent.
